items.title: Bachelor's thesis: license plate recognition
items.description: Studied algorithms for license plate recognition under difficult weather conditions — my first deep dive into computer vision.

items.title: B.Sc. Computer Science, with honors
items.description: Zaporizhzhia Polytechnic National University. Core focus: software architecture, full-stack web development, databases, algorithms & data structures, OOP. Rated H+ in Anabin, Germany's database of foreign institutions — equivalent to a German university; formal recognition (Anerkennung) of the specific degree is a separate bureaucratic step, not a question of qualification.

items.title: First steps in programming
items.description: Started teaching myself to code as a teenager — YouTube, books, early pet projects that haven't survived to this day. That's 6 years of continuous practice since, from the first tutorials to systems running in production today.
